event.description: Test next LayerNorm scalar after sensitive-coordinate rollback
event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,122 parameters at 99.060000%, a +0.060000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 7 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0044 with six cumulative zeros at 2,122 parameters and 99.06%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0045, where additionally zeroing blocks.0.ln1 coordinate 3 scored 97.63%. Hypothesis: that coordinate is specifically carry-sensitive rather than proving all further bias pruning impossible; independently zeroing the next-magnitude candidate, blocks.1.ln1 coordinate 13 at +0.011079432, while omitting the failed coordinate, may preserve qualification and yields 2,121 parameters. This is more informative than testing a still larger scalar because it is the closest untested alternative and separates magnitude ranking from coordinate-specific functional sensitivity.
